subject: Dedicated capacity: throughput qualification & demo scheduling (reschedule requested)
messages:
From: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@blueharbor.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.ruiz@blueharbor.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Dedicated capacity eval (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Karthik,

We just completed a self-serve sign-up and indicated interest in a Dedicated capacity evaluation for our internal inference pipelines. My name is Evelyn (Head of ML Ops at Blue Harbor AI) — Tom (cc'd) is our engineering lead.

High-level ask: we want to understand whether Redwood Dedicated can meet our steady-state needs (~120 QPS at 512 tokens, p95 latency target <120ms) and how autoscale/burst would behave under short spikes to 500 QPS. We're also evaluating quantization tradeoffs and whether prefix/KV caching will help our platform, which has a mix of short interactive queries and batched batched analytics jobs.

Attached is a small workload snapshot (blueharbor_workload_snapshot.csv) and a short answers PDF to the intake questions (throughput-prelim-questions.pdf). Can we schedule a technical walkthrough + calibration call this week? We have availability in the PDT afternoon on Thursday or Friday.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Shaw
Head of ML Ops, Blue Harbor AI
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Dedicated capacity eval (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Evelyn — great to e-meet you, and thanks for the intake packet. I'm Neha from SDR; looping in Karthik (AE) and Ben (Solutions) to run the intake and set a calibration/demo. Quick Qs before we lock a slot: 

- Are your 120 QPS and 512-token numbers steady-state or peak? If steady, what's the typical diurnal swing?
- During spikes to 500 QPS, are those sustained for more than 30s or bursty (under 10s)?
- Do you have a preference for hosted vs. private (we can discuss Dedicated on hosted infra or a Private VPC install)?

Available slots (PDT): Thu 4/16 2:00pm–3:00pm, Thu 4/16 4:30pm–5:00pm (short calibration), Fri 4/17 10:00am–11:00am. Which works best?

If you prefer, we can pencil Fri 4/17 10:00am and Ben will come prepared with a short throughput checklist and an ops playbook.

Thanks!
Neha Kapoor
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@blueharbor.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, tom.ruiz@blueharbor.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Dedicated capacity eval (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Neha — thanks. Quick answers:
- 120 QPS is our target for the realtime endpoint (steady during business hours, with a 30% lower load overnight).
- Spikes to 500 QPS are short bursts (typically 10–20s) caused by scheduled batch commits from clients.
- We'd prefer hosted Dedicated for this evaluation to avoid a full private install initially.

Thu 4/16 afternoon won't work for us (calendar conflict). Friday 4/17 10:00am PDT works for Tom and me — please go ahead and schedule. Also, can you share any pre-call checklist so our infra person can join with the right metrics?

Best,
Evelyn

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Shaw <evelyn.shaw@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Dedicated capacity eval (self-serve sign-up)

Evelyn / Tom — thanks for confirming Friday 4/17 at 10:00am PDT. We're on it. Ben (SE) and Laura (Reliability PM) will lead the calibration and live throughput test. Attached is a short pre-call checklist we typically use; it covers:

- Sample traffic profile (p95, p99 latencies, QPS distribution by hour)
- Top 10 prompt/sequence-length percentiles
- Authentication method (API key / mTLS) and whether keys can be scoped to a test environment
- Sensitive data handling / redaction expectations
- A short curl example we can run during the call for a live latency sample

If you can share exported metrics (even coarse numbers) and confirm you can run a single test API key during the call, we'll be able to simulate the right batch patterns. We'll also bring a strawman bucket of Dedicated instance configurations that match 120 QPS steady-state + burst headroom.

Attachment: throughput-prelim-questions.pdf (same as before)
HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/5821

See you Friday — I'll send a calendar invite in a separate email.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
